description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Command' within the OrangeHRM project, extending Symfony's console command class. It provides common functionality for console commands, including setting up input/output styling with SymfonyStyle.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: An abstract class that extends Symfony's console command, adding customized input/output handling and defining an abstract method for command name retrieval.

methods.name: getIO
methods.description: Returns the SymfonyStyle input/output object used for styling console output.

methods.name: setIO
methods.description: Initializes the SymfonyStyle object with the provided input and output interfaces.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up input/output styling before executing the parent run method to perform the command's main logic.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to specify the command's name.
